messages:
Marcos: quick sync—need a concrete telemetry + policy proposal for automatic fast failover of resident-region writes. Must preserve data residency and avoid split-brain.

Olivia: high level: combine control-plane health, per-tenant replication lag, and explicit tenant consent. auto-failover only when consent && lag below threshold.

Devin: what metric exactly counts as 'replication lag'? per-tenant apply latency vs WAL ack differ in safety for promotions.

Marcos: prefer kv_replication_lag_ms (apply latency to replica commit index). WAL ack too noisy with async buffering.

Kai: emit kv_replication_lag_ms per tenant+region, and surface p50/p95/p99 buckets. Also export last_write_region{tenant} and last_write_ts.

sre-bot: alert: eu-west-1 packet_loss spike 6.7% at 14:03 UTC — tail write latency rising.

Anna: legal constraint: we cannot automatically flip EU-resident tenant writes to non-EU regions unless tenant explicitly opted in. Policy must enforce resident_region.

Marcos: sketching policy + protocol: 
1) tenant config fields:
   - resident_region: string
   - allow_cross_region_failover: boolean (default false)
   - failover_replication_lag_ms: int (default 500)
   - max_auto_failover_qps: int (default 50)

2) signals required:
   - region_controlplane_healthy{region}: bool
   - kv_replication_lag_ms{tenant,region}: numeric
   - last_write_region{tenant}: string
   - probe_connectivity_ok{region}: bool

3) automated two-stage failover protocol:
   - detect: sustained controlplane unhealthy + error tail.
   - preprobe: probe candidate region to warm and verify apply point. N probes.
   - verify: kv_replication_lag_ms(candidate) < threshold AND probe_connectivity_ok.
   - freeze-window: short lease freeze (~50-200ms) to drain inflight L2.
   - switch: atomic route flip, set last_write_region.
   - post-check: audit sweep to confirm no acknowledged writes missing.

Olivia: client opt-in headers for hints/explicit consent:
```
X-Redwood-Resident-Region: eu-west-1
X-Redwood-Allow-Cross-Region-Failover: false
```

Devin: freeze-window worries me at high QPS. Could we rely on idempotent storage + client retries instead? Or restrict auto-failover to low-qps tenants?

Kai: propose max_auto_failover_qps parameter. If tenant QPS > threshold, require manual ops approval.

Anna: add compliance auditing: log justification + metric snapshot whenever cross-region promotion happens for a resident tenant. Retain 1y.

Priya: ops note — telemetry ingestion latency must be <1s for timely decisions; our pipeline is ~3s for some metrics now. Need faster exporter.

Marcos: action items:
 - @Kai: prototype per-tenant kv_replication_lag_ms exporter (deadline Fri)
 - @Olivia: draft RFC and policy fields (next Tue)
 - @Devin: simulation harness for freeze-window at qps buckets (next Wed)
 - @Anna: confirm compliance wording and opt-in language (EOD Thu)

Olivia: conservative defaults: allow_cross_region_failover=false, manual ops for EU->non-EU moves.

Marcos: agreed. once we have metrics + short RFC we'll iterate. Open to adding paranoid checks (e.g., two-phase commit style) in RFC.

Priya: created Grafana prototype dashboard "region-failover-probe" showing kv_replication_lag_ms panel: https://grafana.redwood/example

Devin: starting simulations for 3 QPS buckets (1, 50, 500) and will post results here.

deploy-bot: canary deploy to staging/region-probe-exporter succeeded (2026-03-22T15:12Z).

Marcos: saving notes here for RFC follow-up. Will file RFC with state machine + observability contract. If anyone wants an operator-override TTL or forced-revert playbook, mention now.

Olivia: added appendix suggestion: operator-override TTL + forced-revert playbook in case of mispromotion.

Anna: compliance ok with initial approach if opt-in defaults are strict.

Marcos: thanks all — closing sync, will ping when RFC is filed. :thumbsup:
